iterations: v001: plan from the roof view (back row 1010 px for 76.4 m, 0.0756 m/px); the front row parted round the shaft; heights proportioned in the oblique (26 m walls, 3 m caps, gallery 31 to 35 m, shaft to 36 m, head house eave 47 m).

findings: Massing: two rows of eight concrete silos 9.2 m across, the front row parted round a concrete shaft that stands 2.3 m proud of it, a corrugated head house over both rows, a gallery the length of the cluster; the oblique through the fitted camera and the roof view through the orthographic camera agree with this.
Silos: pour lines every 2.4 m, conical caps with sixteen ribs, an apex hatch and a ring railing on posts; discharge spouts at the outer silos' feet.
Shaft: a column of six windows in recessed openings with glass and a dark room behind, a door at grade, and a door onto each walkway from its side faces.

Head house: gable ends and long sides in corrugated steel, a closed underside, a roof with overhangs, a louvre in the front gable, two ridge ventilators, and two posts carrying its north overhang down to the back row caps.
Gallery: corrugated sides and gable ends, a closed underside, a ridged roof, and steel frames down to the caps at every column with a cross beam and brace.
Sheds and bays: two sheds, each two silos wide, with two cut bays 3.8 m by 4.6 m opening into 5.4 m deep dark interiors, sloping roofs that stop at the shaft, and concrete pads in front.
Walkways: decks at 10 m along the front row with a guard rail and mid rail, posts every 1.6 m and brackets back to the silos, ending at doors in the shaft.
open_notes: Gate A: variant_2.png (the street view) is a grey render of the old LEGO model. A person must rule that the oblique and roof views govern, or supply a street view.
